title: skeletons rearmed
description: skeletons with swords and wither skeletons with bows
body:
A very simple and probably fully compatible with everything mod, which forses skeletons rarely spawn naturally with a stone sword as a main weapon. The same applies to wither skeletons, but with a bow.
Now it's only for NeoForge because I made this mod for my friends, but I might port it to other platforms if someone asks.










If you any questions, wishes, ideas and so on feel free to contact me om planet minecraft: https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/frogen
or by mail in my profile.
